data.segment_title: Campaign 2008 / Obama vs. McCain / Battleground States
data.segment_description:
(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The final battleground in the presidential election campaign between Senators Barack Obama & John McCain introduced; map of states being visited by the two candidates shown.  

(Miami: Chip Reid)  The fight for Florida & other Southern battleground states featured.  [In Miami, McCAIN - says Cuba will be free; speaks about taxes.]  [In Virginia, OBAMA - campaigns against McCain & President Bush.]  

(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  Findings of a CNN/"Time" poll on Obama's lead over McCain with Florida voters cited.  

(Tampa: Kelly Cobiella)  The contest for the I-4 corridor, home for a diverse group of voters in Florida, featured; details given about the likely voter groups for each candidate in the state.  [Unemployed Floridian Jim PICHILLO%- says the Republican National Convention hit a nerve.]  [Former Tampa Mayor Dick GRECO@- backs McCain.]  [University of South Florida Susan MacMANUS@- assesses the Florida voter.]  

(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The early voting in North Carolina reported; poll findings cited.  

(Raleigh, North Carolina: Jeff Greenfield)  The organized fight for votes in the state of North Carolina featured; scenes shown of vote canvassers for Obama; details given about Obama's money advantage.  [Obama supporter Allisa ENGLISH@- talks about registering high school students.]  [Obama campaign state director Marc FARINELLA@- talks about the volunteers.]  ["The News & Observer" writer Rob CHRISTENSEN@- talks about the Starbucks Republicans.]  [Obama volunteer Eferem HURDLE@, Senator Richard BURR@- comment on the race.]  

(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The fight for re-election by North Carolina Senator Elizabeth Dole & the "Chicago Tribune"'s first endorsement of a Democrat for president noted.  

(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric; Washington: Bob Schieffer)  How it will be hard for McCain to win: that he must win all of the toss-up states plus two states leaning to Obama & how he will portray Obama as a big-spending liberal discussed.  

(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The guests on "Face the Nation" noted.
(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The housing construction figures for the month, billionaire Warren Buffett's advice to buy stocks & the Stock Market Report reported.

[Las Vegas metropolitan police Capt. Vincent CANNITO@- says this is as bad as it gets.]  Photo shown of Cole's grandfather Clemens Tinnemeyer@, who is involved with drug traffickers. data.segment_title: North Carolina / Senate Race / Dole vs. Hagan
data.segment_description: (Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The threat to Senator Elizabeth Dole's re-election in North Carolina examined; scenes shown of her campaigning against state senator Kay Hagan@; TV ad shown.  [HAGAN - criticizes Dole for voting with President Bush; states farmers are backing her because of jobs.]  [DOLE - says it's jobs, jobs, jobs; notes former President George Bush & First Lady Laura Bush have campaigned for her; calls the Hagan ad an attack on her age.]   (Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  Next week's further coverage of Midwest & Western battleground states previewed.

(Charlotte, North Carolina: Katie Couric)  The defeat for Alaska Governor Sarah Palin with the federal government's classification of the beluga whale as an endangered species in the state's Cook Inlet reported.
